snippets.text: What's up, boys? Got another guide for
you today. Something quite important,
but easy to miss. So, you know how you
have to collect those feathers around
the map in order to get extra skill
points for your character? Well, by
default, the map doesn't actually show
you any of the feathers on the map. So,
even if you have uh let me pull that up.
Give me a second here.
Oh, okay. There we go. So, we got uh
this map from Google. You can see the
link here. Uh you can see all of the
feathers on the map that you need to
collect.
Put that down. As you can see, they
don't show on your regular map. To make
them show, all you have to do is you
have to go here on filter settings and
click the content check mark. And now on
the big map, you will see all of your
feathers and all of the other stuff that
you would see on your mini map as well.
And this just makes it infinitely easier
to know what you have collected, what
you haven't, and to get all of those.
And it's very important that you get
them because they give you permanent
character. They give you permanent
character progression. They give you
skill points and those are additive. So
the more of them you get, the more skill
points that you'll get. Originally, it
starts with one skill point, but
eventually you start getting four at a
time, and that's basically an entire uh
end game skill point. It's very, very
massive damage boost. So, you want to
get these eventually. So, make sure you
look around and get all of them. Uh the
map also shows you where you can get the
cubes, which are also very important
because they give you more points for
dungeons, so you can get more loot.
Anyways, that was it. Just wanted to
show you guys how to make that stuff
show up. Have a nice one.
